movie.title: Paths of Glory
movie.overview: A commanding officer defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.

facts: The film's compelling story has roots in real history! It's adapted from a novel that was inspired by the actual Souain corporals affair during World War I.
Stanley Kubrick wasn't the only creative mind behind the script. He co-wrote the powerful screenplay alongside Calder Willingham and Jim Thompson.
Before it hit the big screen, 'Paths of Glory' was a significant 1935 novel by Humphrey Cobb. It's cool how such an impactful story originated decades earlier in print!
